messages:
Ellen: Hey teamMorning! Quick holiday micro-event idea: a Secret Mug Exchange (swap anonymously, leave on front-desk shelf). Low effort, max coffee vibes. Who's in? :mug:

Ravi: In! Will trade for artisan hot chocolate mix. Also can we do an optional 'mug story' note with each gift? Tiny notes = best part. :memo:

Sam: Count me in. Are we doing price cap? I have a tendency to go very niche expensive. :grimacing:

Priya: Suggestion: $15 cap and 'no candles' rule (last year's candle triggered facilities). :no_entry_sign: :candle:

Juno: I can coordinate matches. If you're in, DM me your desk location and mug preferences (tea/coffee/latte). I'll post pairings by Wednesday. :sparkles:

Ellen: Price cap agreed. Also tiny twist: add a 'holiday tag' sticker so we know it's part of the exchange (not random office ware). Sticker design in the kitchen. :label:

santa-bot: "Reminder: Secret Mug Exchange sign-ups close in 48 hours."

Ravi: Photo: (uploaded) "ravi_mug_choice.jpg"  
"Blue enamel travel mug, accepts tea. Will include a bad holiday pun note." :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

Sam: GIF: <https://giphy.com/gifs/holiday-coffee-3o6Mb9o2X6G6> 

Priya: Tiny logistics Q: can remote folks ship in or opt out? I have two remote teammates who want to participate.

Juno: Remote folks welcome to ship (mark as "remote" on sign-up form) or opt-out. I'll provide a mailing address (workshop PO box) if needed.

Ellen: Quick vote: react with :mug: if in-person pick-up, :earth_americas: if remote shipping, :raised_hands: if both. I'll close the poll tonight and announce matches.

Ravi: Also volunteering to be backup recipient if someone forgets to pick up their mug. :handshake:

Juno: Matches posted tonight at 8pm PST. Thank you everyone  Happy low-stress gifting. :heart:
